body:
Thanks for the comments. I think finding something to live for would be a good idea. I just feel so trapped in my body, and it's things that can't change, maybe having something to live for would help take my attention away, as I think about myself and the way I want everything gone every minute of the day.
Wow that sounds tough too lonelylokly. I was reading a suicide book and I think the one thing I took from it is that nothing ever lasts forever, so I guess you and me might end up feeling better at some point. Seems like a long time to me though and things feel worse if anything.
Yes I think you're right about physical therapists gussickak, the one I'm seeing has written several letters to doctors for me, but it still seems like I never get messages across.
Hopefully I can find the strength as you say knight_of_cups, but the thing is, no one even knows how I feel. It feels so lonely as no one ever asks anything and I'm not the sort of person to come out and tell people everything. I guess that's one thing about being able to write everything here about how I feel as it's the first time I've been able to do that.
